description: SpecKit for Claude Code: the tasks.md guard on Edit, Write and Bash while beads holds the task state. Asks before a subagent touches a resource its OpenCode rules ask about; Claude Code ignores subagent hooks of plugins.

hooks.command: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/claude-hook.js" pre-tool-use; fi; exit 0

R="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/agent-guard.mjs"; I=$(cat); X=; if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then X=node; elif command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then X=bun; fi; if [ -n "$X" ] && O=$(printf '%s' "$I" | "$X" "$R") && [ -n "$O" ]; then printf '%s' "$O"; else printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"agent guard could not run; asking instead"}}'; fi; exit 0
